explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/505: 'This is trivially true for n = 1 and easy for n = 2. For n = 3 it is true, which was proved by Eggleston.' The Lean statement: for n ≤ 3, BorsukConjecture n (every bounded set with at least two points in ℝⁿ is covered by n+1 sets of strictly smaller diameter). The case n = 0 is vacuous (ℝ⁰ has one point). Faithful.
